Generator.description:
The script a generated sheet is built by. A sheet with a generator is not edited by hand:
change the script and run ``cheme regen``.

script.description: Generator script from the repository root, e.g. scripts/draft_P-04.py. `cheme regen` copies the frame to a scratch file, runs `cheme run SCRIPT FILE` (the script edits FILE in place) and formats the result.
script.title: Script

frame.description: What the script starts from: a file in the repository (e.g. pid/frames/P-04.xml) or a git revision whose copy of the sheet file is the frame (e.g. 9aa9b38, the commit with the empty sheet). Quote a revision of digits only ('8203912'): unquoted, YAML reads it as a number.
frame.title: Frame

Generator.title: Generator

Project.description:
The project the plant is engineered in: what ``cheme sheet new`` writes into the
title block of each sheet (MetaData and the title-block texts).
Project.title: Project

Sheet.description:
One P&ID sheet, a DEXPI 2.0.1 XML file.

A ``planned`` sheet is part of the sheet split but not drawn yet: without its file it is
reported as info (``cheme.sheet-planned``), and the listed items assigned to it
(``sheet:``) are not reported missing from the P&IDs. Once the file exists it is validated
like any other sheet. ``cheme sheet new`` writes the file and marks the sheet drafted.

id.description: Sheet number as printed, e.g. P-01.
id.title: Id

file.description: Path from the repository root, e.g. pid/P-01.xml (default pid/<id>.xml).
file.title: File

kind.description: pid: a P&ID; bfd/pfd: a block or process flow diagram generated from process/*.yaml by `cheme process build` (file default process/<id>.xml).
kind.title: Kind

generator.description: Set for a generated sheet (rebuilt by `cheme regen`, no hand edits); leave out for a hand-maintained sheet. bfd/pfd sheets: flowsheet (the default).
generator.title: Generator

status.description: planned: declared, not drawn yet (no file needed); drafted: the file exists.
status.title: Status
